The fine_grained_classifier failed to identify it as a 'street sign' (ranking it 3rd behind 'scoreboard' and 'digital clock'), indicating the visual features do not strongly align with the class definition. Only geometric silhouette and color contrast checkpoints passed. The object mimics the form but fails the function and specific identity of a street sign.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text gibberish (Severity 5) dominates the artifact profile. Structural fusion between the arrow sign and the pole (Severity 4) indicates a breakdown in physical connectivity logic. Secondary issues include perspective warping of text lines and smeared pole texture. The high mask confidence from the topology auditor (0.95) is misleading here; it confirms the AI generated a coherent 'blob' shape, but does not validate the internal structural logic or boundary sharpness against the background, which the Router correctly flagged as problematic.
